name: Lasitehtaantie Flats
description: The 1974 block on Lasitehtaantie, where the glassworks used to be. Leena lets a damp basement studio and a proper one-room flat upstairs. Shared sauna turns on Thursdays.
greeting: Someone is beating a rug in the yard.
A notice on the door: 'Sauna turn: Thursday 18-19'.
The neighbour's dog barks at nothing.

hello: Remember: no shoes on the stairs.
The laundry room is booked till Sunday.
Is that your bicycle in the hallway?
lease_basement: Mind your head on the pipes. Rent is due at the start of every month.
It's cosy! Some would say damp. I say cosy.
lease: Here are your keys. Rent is due at the start of every month.
pay_rent: Lovely. I'll write you a receipt.
relax: Don't play the TV too loud.
pellinen: Tell him to open a window. Please.
Pellinen's rent is always on time. I have no idea how.
If you see daylight on him, tell me. I'll call the paper.
broke: The first month up front, I'm afraid.
Come back when you have it.
refuse: That's not how it works here.

lines: You click the lamp on and off. On. Off. On. The neighbour bangs on the wall.
The lampshade has a cigarette burn shaped like Finland. Upside down.
Three paperbacks, a phone book from 2004 and "Excel for Beginners". Your library.
You open a book. A €5 note falls out! No. It's a bookmark that looks like a €5 note.
Pellinen lent you a book called "Winning at Life". The receipt is still in it. So is a lottery ticket. It didn't win.

actions.label: Rent the basement studio
actions.description: Cheap, and next door to Pellinen. One small window at ankle height. Rent is due monthly; the first month is paid now.

then.message: You carry your things down to the basement. It smells of damp and of Pellinen's pizza.

else.message: You get the keys to the basement studio. It is small and damp, but it is yours.

actions.label: Rent the one-room flat
actions.description: Third floor, a balcony and a view of the old glassworks chimney. Rent is due monthly; the first month is paid now.

then.message: You haul your boxes up from the basement. Daylight! Pellinen waves from his doorway without looking away from the screen.

else.message: You get the keys. A proper flat of your own!

then.message: You lie on the sofa again. The ceiling has not changed since last time.
Sauna turn, then the sofa in your underwear with ice hockey on TV. Pure kalsarikännit.

else.message: Sauna turn, then the sofa in your underwear with a book. A TV would make this perfect.

actions.label: Game night at Pellinen's
actions.description: Pellinen lives in the basement and has not been outside since spring. His door is always open, and the second controller is always charged.

do.message: Pellinen is in a ranked match. You watch him play for five hours. He narrates. You learn nothing.
"You again?" Pellinen hands you the controller with the sticky button. You lose every round.
Second night in a row. Your eyes are square. Pellinen looks exactly the same as always, which is worrying.
Pellinen hasn't seen daylight since the last patch. You play until four in the morning. He's honestly great company.
Pellinen carries the whole team, then explains every mistake you made. Twice. You still had a great time.
Energy drinks, cold pizza and a raid that lasts six hours. Pellinen says you're "not totally useless". High praise.
Pellinen shows you his speedrun. It is genuinely impressive. He asks you not to tell his mother how long it took to learn.
